study.question: Does lifecycle v2 (the per-step trust-region curvature clamp) remove the graft's germination-stage divergence on the norm and conv_heavy seeds of the under_normalized host, for the derived reason, without changing the graft where v1 is already safe?
study.scope: Covers both seeds that put kappa above c* on this host (norm, conv_heavy), plus a regression cell, and reports host-arm instability (the seed-2142 static divergence class) as its own criterion. It does not measure graft value: that is a later, separately pre-registered graft-capture study.

units.definition: one training seed in one cell; v1 and v2 of that seed share initialization and every minibatch, and within each run the three arms are matched repeated measures
units.population_note: Inference covers training randomness on one fixed data sample (data_seed 20261004) for the three declared host x seed cells.

endpoint.metric: development cross-entropy (nats) over all 5,000 dev examples
endpoint.per_unit_reduction: mean dev CE over the late epochs per arm; None for an arm that diverged

predictions.c1: Expected pass. Under v2, the recorded trust curvature is <= 0.5 c* at every STE step, and the witness validator rejects any run that breaks it. P(0/48) at a true v2 lifecycle-divergence rate of 0.5% / 1% / 2% / 6.25%: 0.786 / 0.617 / 0.379 / 0.045 ((1-p)^48, assuming independence). Cells A and B share one host per seed, so the 48 units are 24 host trajectories x 2 seed types and these figures are optimistic; per-cell bounds (0/24: 12.5% rule of three, 11.7% exact one-sided) are the honest per-seed-type claim. Predicted residual v2 failure mode (theory review): where the clamp engages, the forced gain equilibrium scales as 1/rms(h), so any v2 failure should appear at blending entry (CE instability). C1 counts it.
predictions.c2: Expected testable and passing. P(no v1 STE divergence in cell A alone) at a 25% rate = 0.75^24 = 0.001. C2a (falsification) is predicted to hold because kappa > c* is the derived mechanism, but it is a weak test: survivors cross c* too. C2b (intervention) is the mechanism evidence: v1-only divergences on seeds that v2 keeps. The within-cell ranking AUC of the rectified growth score is reported, not gated; it may fall below 0.9 because the linear limit does not decide which over-limit units diverge.
predictions.c3: Expected pass: shown bitwise on the 7-epoch smoke pair (test_variant_independent_arms_are_bitwise_equal_across_variants) and the GPU probe shows bitwise replay per device; both variants of one seed run on the same GPU.
predictions.c4: Expected pass with verdict 'equivalent' and v2_units_clamped = 0 (conv_light on the mild host, kappa ~0.3 in the pilot), in which case v2 equals v1 exactly and the guard is trivially met. The report states the clamp-engagement count so a trivial pass is visible.
predictions.c5: Not predicted. The static arm diverged once on this host in positive-control-v2 (seed 2142). C5 reports host-arm divergences; it does not decide acceptance.
predictions.would_surprise: Any v2 lifecycle divergence in A or B; a v1 STE-epoch divergence in the stable cells (A, B) with pre-divergence max kappa below c*/1.1; a replay mismatch, within or across cells.

disclosures: Exploratory engineering acceptance test (docs/bounded-lifecycle-v2.md), pre-registered so the criteria cannot move after the data. It is not a confirmatory study of graft value.
The divergence rate on cell A under v1 is already public (positive-control-v1 12/48; reproduction 6/16), and the mechanism was derived from those runs.

PILOT-INFORMED AMENDMENTS. Two 3-seed GPU dry runs (seeds 9201-9203; docs/results/2026-10-08-lifecycle-v2-dryrun-1 and -2) preceded launch. Dry run 1 found the float32 witness defect (every clamped v2 run failed verification). Two pre-launch reviews (theory and statistics) read the pilot's per-step records and criteria output, and their findings, including pilot numbers, reached the author. C2 was then restructured (falsification on pre-divergence STE rows with a declared bilinear allowance of 0.1; an intervention gate; ranking reported, not gated; within-cell AUC on a rectified score), the runner was changed (float32 lambda recorded; gain_at_birth read back from the parameter), and reporting was added. Seeds 9201-9206 are excluded. Dry run 3 (seeds 9204-9206, commit a2d1062; docs/results/2026-10-08-lifecycle-v2-dryrun-3) was read for mechanics only: 18/18 units verified, C3 held on 9/9 pairs and across cells, and no clamped row (629) exceeded s*c*. The statistics reviewer additionally ran the amended criteria on dry run 2's records.
data_identity was copied from positive-control-v2 manifests (same data_seed, train_size and dev_size).

Pre-germination scheduled divergences are host instability (the scheduled arm is the no-growth host until its seed exists, enforced by verify_pairing). They are excluded from C1 and C2 and reported in C5. Post-germination divergences that coincide with a host-arm divergence of the same cell and seed are flagged, not reclassified.
STE-epoch divergence is identified by the divergence record carrying the STE table, not by its stage label: a divergence in the STE epoch's scoring is recorded with the stage after the epoch.

nan handling: a nan kappa is never ranked or compared. A positive with no finite pre-divergence kappa is a falsification miss; a negative with none is counted toward specificity and listed as unranked.
The recorded effective curvature satisfies <= s*c* in float64 using the float32 lambda the loss multiplies; the graph's own float32 arithmetic is exact to ~1e-7 relative.

Execution profile: GPU, Academy-exact per SKU (2x RTX 4060 Ti); GPU lineage only. Both variants of a seed run on the same GPU. max_failed_units = 0 with no retries: any non-divergence crash reads instrument_failure.
Analysis must run promptly on this host with a GPU visible: verify_run compares each manifest's runtime (hostname, platform, CPU count, GPU name) with the analysing process.

The criteria are computed by experiments/lifecycle_validation.py (evaluate_criteria), whose hash is pinned at launch; the snapshot and commit pin the rest of the rule (validate_witness, verify_run, interval). The PDR states them in prose.
